title: Committed Process Hydraulic View Runtime Binding
purpose: Source-bind the exact qualified F-SI17 process hydraulic view onto the exact qualified F-MR06 physical runtime so process orchestration can obtain hydraulic information from F-KT committed state without exposing candidate, checkpoint or solver-internal state.

new_runtime_surface.committed_binding: The runtime obtains an opaque F-KT snapshot from kernel_committed_state_t, admits only fmr_b110_physical_state_t, maps its hydraulic fields through the exact F-SI17 builder and returns a detached view snapshot.

required_properties: Valid committed B1.10 physical state yields exact pressure head, water content, ponding depth and groundwater level.
Returned arrays do not alias committed state.
Mutation of an uncommitted clone cannot affect a subsequently rebuilt committed view.
Snow-active and snow-inactive committed states expose the same hydraulic contract without reading or changing snow state.
A/B/A committed-state view construction is deterministic.
Exact F-MR06 snow/physical regression remains green with every original production blob unchanged.
non_goals: No irrigation state or event counters.
No change to SNOW, mass accounting or physical solver results.
